svg.title: T09 Adventure motorcycle, left side elevation
svg.desc: Large adventure tourer: beak front mudguard and high mudguard, adjustable screen, hand guards, Telelever front suspension, boxer twin with cylinder guards, crash bars and sump guard, shaft drive in a single-sided Paralever swingarm, aluminium panniers on a luggage rack, 19/17 in spoked tubeless wheels with dual-purpose tyres.
